verdicts.human_summary: getYarnVersion() helper functions call getProjectRoot() independently, causing repeated filesystem traversals. Suggests passing the already-computed root into these helpers.
verdicts.reasoning: AI Comment 0 raises the same concern: both getYarnVersionFromPackageJson and hasYarnBerryConfig call getProjectRoot() independently rather than accepting it as a parameter from the caller. It recommends adding an optional root parameter to each helper and having getYarnVersion pass a single getProjectRoot() result to both — the same fix the human suggests.

verdicts.human_summary: find.up('package.json') stops at the first package.json found. In a workspace/monorepo, if a nested package.json lacks packageManager field, the function returns undefined instead of continuing upward to find the root package.json that declares packageManager: yarn@..., causing Berry misclassification.
verdicts.reasoning: No AI comment addresses the logic error of find.up stopping at the first package.json without continuing to search ancestor directories for one that actually declares the packageManager field. The AI comments focus on parameter passing consistency (Comment 0/1/6), test duplication (Comment 2/3), missing test coverage for yarn@1 (Comment 4), and dead code (Comment 5).
